Create a FastAPI NDJSON stream stub.

```python
from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse
import json

async def generate():
    yield json.dumps({"type": "token", "data": {"text": "hi"}}) + "\n"
    yield json.dumps({"type": "done", "data": {"ok": True}}) + "\n"

return StreamingResponse(generate(), media_type="application/x-ndjson")
```
